reviews.title: Nice colors and great performance!
reviews.comment: Bought this to replace a different pump that went bad. The RGB colors are great, looks very sharp and ties into my computer well. I didn’t need to use the software as my RGB motherboard controller did the job, but their software is an option if you need it. This pump actually ran cooler than the original pump I bought ever did! I was running about 90c which is way too hot and my CPU was throttling. Once this was installed it was down to 65c!! That’s a huge difference! Setup was easy, good directions, and it had all the adapters for an AMD or Intel CPU. It was also cheaper than a lot of others I looked at, so a great value!
reviews.author: Edward Traylor

reviews.title: This makes me wish I'd ditched the air coolers years ago now...
reviews.comment: Simply Amazing. I've never been one afraid to spend on my PC, but also valued reliability and above all, noise.  As such, I've firmly been in the Noctua (with the occasional deviation) air-coolers, culminating most recently in the NH-D15 G2... an absolute beast of a cooler that overwhelmed everything in my case, made it hard to work on anything, and was way noisier than I expected. So after a TON of research, this replaced it....and man, is it quiet.  Definitely nothing flashy about it if you're looking for RGB (there is zero), but I have RGB in the other elements of my case - I don't need it everywhere.  What this DOES give me is the ability to keep both fans and pumps turned down to inaudible (on a 9800X3D), which I love.  I can hear the pump if I put my ear next to it, but with the case on?  Nada.  All this, while dropping the ambient temps of my CPU by around 5C at idle, and way more at load (while being quieter at every level). Highly recommend if you value silence.
reviews.author: Kevin Whitley

reviews.title: Don't wait make the swap AIO is the way to be and this is the one!
reviews.comment: I bought a Costco Prebuilt PC (Aegis R2) with a I9 14000f  and a 4070 Super the CPU Cooler was a radiator/FAN. I mostly play WoW on almost ultra settings and my CPU Temp was idle about 74c and under load could range from 80c-94c! so not optimal for long term gaming, with a little dust it was riding the higher end of the temps more often. I decided to finally break down and buy an AIO Cooler and its been absolutely impressive, Idle at desktop is 25c-30c, idle in game With my setting cranked to ultra I am 45c-54 and under complete load in game I am around 54c-61c max. I have also run the Cinebench CPU Benchmark and max Temp throughout the test was 74c. Another note any Temp below 70c My PC is almost Completely silent after the install and even above that its quieter than it ever was. I purchased the 360 Atmos because I could fit it and it was like $20 more than the other unit. It was a snug to fit into my case opening however once it was in it fit very nicely. It is definitely a high quality item that was packaged very well and everything included was well labeled. Also I did not see it mentioned anywhere but there is thermal paste included. I ended up ordering some Artic thermal paste for the install I did end up using the one I ordered. The only "CON" if you can call it that is that the installation instructions are pictures only and if you aren't 100% sure what you are looking at it can be a touch confusing as they give you extra cords for different ways to set up the LEDS. it hung me up for a bit however there was a fantastic YT tutorial that gave in detail instructions for this exact unit and he even talks about all of the extra parts as well. I am intermediate in PC building knowledge and it took about an hour to replace the radiator setup. I did accidentally follow the wrong wire and unplug a wrong wire and had to do some tracing to find out what it was and where it plugged into that was my bad lol... All in all I would absolutely recommend this unit to anyone looking to cool their CPU down price is 100% reasonable for what you get.
reviews.author: Kmikelg

reviews.title: Quiet cooler !
reviews.comment: I'm using this to cool my 7950x3d. Granted, it doesn't need a 360mm AIO, but I care more about the noise the fans make. The Atmos Stealth is quiet as a mouse, I can barely hear it during day to day productivity tasks. It keeps temps. low in the 50s. The only time the fans become audible is during gaming sessions. Note, at full blast, these fans will be loud and sound like an industrial blower.
reviews.author: Monil

reviews.title: Is Good.
reviews.comment: Ice cold. Quiet. Easy to install. Hadn't used liquid cooling before, but upgrading from an intel gen 7 to a Ryzen 9800 required new mounts. This works, keeps the new processor cooler than the old Cooler Master fan+radiator setup on the old processor and is quieter. Plus it's cheap.
reviews.author: Talon Townley
